commits.subject: vulkan: add RDNA3 to the subgroup-size config table (wave32) + surface the resolved subgroup size
commits.evidence: Upstream cf2270e4d (vulkan: subgroup size tuning, #12087) added gpu_pipeline_configs covering RDNA1 and RDNA2 only. The RDNA3 row is ours - upstream has no such entry, so there is nothing to take from. The upstream commit is cited as the CONTEXT for the omission, not as a source.

owed_trailers.Origin: ArifiLabs (native) - RDNA3 was absent from upstream's subgroup-size table, so get_subgroup_size() returned 0 and the backend was configured for wave64 on a part whose native compute mode is wave32.
owed_trailers.Measured-effect: AMD Radeon 780M (gfx1103), subgroupSize 64 / min 32 / max 64, subgroupSizeControl true. Banner before: "warp size: 64". After: "warp size: 32".

commits.subject: vulkan: runtime dispatch threshold for the matvec/GEMM fork (GGML_VK_MMV_MAX_COLS)
commits.evidence: Splits an existing compile-time bound (mul_mat_vec_max_cols) out as a clamped runtime env value so the matvec-vs-coopmat dispatch can be A/B'd on ONE binary. Original; no upstream or third-party equivalent is cited in the body or exists under that name.

owed_trailers.Origin: ArifiLabs (native) - the compile-time bound was also the runtime dispatch decision at three call sites, which put the VK_KHR_cooperative_matrix pipelines out of reach for 2-8 token rows (the drafted-verify batch widths) by software rather than by hardware.
owed_trailers.Measured-effect: UNMEASURED - default unset = 8 = unchanged behaviour; the knob lowers only, because raising would index the pipeline arrays out of bounds. It is an instrument, not a lever.
